t:
It's Antonis! He makes us do that. The Guards of the Order gave him a great power. He says he will use it drive all humans away from the lake shores!

When Julis tried to contradict, Antonis almost killed him. It sparked off a real rebellion! Prince Janis fled with his wounded father, and I wanted to leave with them - but I was too scared. Let me go, please! I don't want to fight.
r133574.n: Ask why the lake people are attacking the boats

t: Alright, we don't have time for chatting. Take you sword and slay the bastards! We can talk afterwards...

Stop! Who goes there?

Are you from the Iron City?
r133700.n: Stop! Who goes there? Are you from the Iron City?

t: You say the harbor is safe? As if I would believe it! The monsters are coming from there. I will hide here until the reinforcement from the Iron City arrives!
None of this would have happened in Nezebgrad...
r133724.n: None of this would have happened in Nezebgrad...

t:
Get away! Don't touch me, you demon! Your words won't confuse me!

May the Light save us...
What? The Alliance? I don't know anything about any Alliance! I want my Yegor back! Where is here? Are the monsters gone?

Eyes! They stare, and stare, and then the light. And my soul - phew! My soul's gone! Hahaha! Looking for the soul, hahaha! The soul's gone, HE took it. HE sees everything! Where there was lighthouse, now HE is!

Time! Time heals, heals the souls. When time isn't flowing, the soul isn't living. Ahaha! Sparks are scattered around, oh...

HE! HE is looking! And seeing everything!
Soul... Where is my soul?! Have you seen it?
r133855.n: Soul... Where is my soul?! Have you seen it?

t: If anything goes wrong, I didn't see you!

There ain't nothing difficult in handling these idiots. Just shout loud enough and make sure to pop your eyes out to make them fear you!

Remember the commands: "Move it", "Wrong way" and "Freeze". They don't get it any other way, believe me.

If any of them dies, there ain't no big deal. Just don't let the bomb explode, or we're all dead.

Return to Umoir? No way. I won't have anything to do with that drama queen again.

Though... Ah, taking the helm of Eclipse is worth putting up with the temper of its owner.

Damn those rotten rats! I haven't drunk a single drop of water in the last three days.

You are right in time, friend. They were about to start shredding my skin...

Why? For no reason. If there were a reason, they would have killed me right away. Just some old grudge...
r134170.n: Damn those rotten rats! I haven't drunk a single drop of water in the…

t:
Egh, come on! We have nothing to do with that. Haven't you heard of the Mercenaries' code, eh? We are the Free Traders' guards, and we are just executing their orders.

They told us to beat you up. So go and sort this out with them. This is none of our business!
Hey you! You got problem, fella?
r134180.n: Hey you! You got problem, fella?

t:
I loved it! We didn't have a good concert in a while. Since the King and Jester band left. It was such fun!

A whole crowd gathered. All kinds of people were in it. The cheerful troll brought a keg of good beer. There was a girl asking about the June treasures... and there was... what was his name... the one with horns! Constantly whining. I don't remember...

What? You've been looking for the girl? She and that guy with horns, they hugged each other and went away along the eastern road.

Listen, if you ever see him, hand him this bottle. Let him drink it and remember the party we had! Maybe it helps him stop whining.
r134343.n: How do you like my music?

t:
What? Who?

Huh!

What's wrong with you? Just let an honest goblin work!

There was this girl with a shovel. She also wanted to know about that pilgrim of yours. She sneaked around, sniffing, putting her nose in every corner, writing down something.

I don't care. She can do whatever she likes as long as she doesn't get in my way.
I'm busy. Leave me alone now.
r134809.n: Have you seen pilgrim Fedor Svyatoslavov around?

t:
Well, that's a pity. A real trader will never waste a bread crust, not to mention two fists!
Thank my trade clerk, he's found them. Here they are. Make sure not to lose them again.

r136009.n: Ouch, that hurt! What do you want? I don't know anything, I'm not in…

t: Ouch, that hurt! What do you want? I don't know anything, I'm not in charge! I'm just a simple worker just trying to earn some coin!
r136010.n: Ouch, that hurt! What do you want? I don't know anything, I'm not in…

t:
Alright, I'll tell you everything, just don't beat me anymore! The mafia runs the show here. They have all of the dark artifacts. They carry them to the distant anomalies beyond the Cordon!
Do you want those artifacts? Well, you should ask them for them, but I'm sure they won't give them to you for free! You better be ready for a tough fight!
Ouch, that hurt! What do you want? I don't know anything, I'm not in charge! I'm just a simple worker just trying to earn some coin!
r136012.n: Ouch, that hurt! What do you want? I don't know anything, I'm not in…

t: Wow, it has pictures! This is awesome! Even a lamia could understand this book.
Interesting... And how does he expect me to execute this order if all my men are captured?
Thank Tensess! What news do you have? Are we going to begin a general offensive soon?
r136503.n: Thank Tensess! What news do you have? Are we going to begin a general…

t: Oh... An order... I would have preferred a pot of porridge though.
Okay, you may enter the Temple at will.
r136657.n: Ask for permission to enter Tensess Temple

t: Okay, you may enter the Temple at will.
r136658.n: Ask for permission to enter Tensess Temple

t: Here you go, make sure to read the entire thing!
r136859.n: Can I have a brochure please?

t: Hello adventurer. Do you need something?
r136860.n: Hello adventurer. Do you need something?

r137058.n: Я хочу перестать получать опыт за победу над другими персонажами

r137059.n: Я хочу вновь получать опыт за победу над другими персонажами

t: What's wrong? I don't know anything!

To use the items pu-... put them on the... the hillside... The first one needs to...
Oh, who's there?
Yeah, I'll translate it for you.
r137637.n: Yeah, I'll translate it for you.

t:
When you raise your Flag of War you will then be able to attack members of the League. However, they will also be able to attack you. If you decide not to partake in the hostilities, simply refrain from attacking League soldiers for a 5 minutes, and your Flag will lower.
You also should know that when your Flag of War is raised here in the Holy Land your experience gain will increase by 10%. I strongly recommend that you aid the Empire and eradicate the League menace!
r137656.n: Ask about the Flag of War

t: Take this banner! It will help you with your mission.
Before I give it to you, vow that you will pay a better attention when dealing with such things!
r137675.n: Ask for the Amulet of True Faith

t: If that honorable smuggler is not lying, it means that a great war lies ahead of us. And when it's upon us, there will be no time for diplomacy. I don't think something really depends on me now. I will send a message our command to urge them to put their troops on full combat alert. My mission here is over.
Greetings! I believe we have not before.
r137748.n: Greetings! I believe we have not before.

t: This man is not lying, believe me. If everything is really that serious, and the Architects are ready to launch a full-scale invasion, we need to act right now! I will contact my command immediately and demand putting all our military divisions on full combat alert.
Good day, comrade! How can I help you?
r137756.n: Good day, comrade! How can I help you?

t:
Architects? Never heard of them. But I can see you are telling the truth...

So you found a passage that led beyond Sarnaut on Ferris? You stirred up a wasps' nest, and now the wasps strive for revenge? Interesting, interesting...

As far as I understand, Architects are not actually gods. They are not creators but something else. Modifiers? Probably. They can modify space as well as time...
r138136.n: Tell Klavdia Kalugina about the Architects and the assault on Dane

t:
So, what do we have here?

Huh! The new play with the old actors.

May I ask, what you are doing here?
r138137.n: So, what do we have here? Huh! The new play with the old actors. May I…

t:
And where is it now? Disappeared? Huh!

Stop fooling me. If something exists, it cannot just melt into thin air. Unless you travel to the past and make it never exist in the first place... But only gods can do that, not the likes of us.

Tell me, who did you meet there?

A Thrasher? It goes as a "stool" in my classification. Who else? A pyramide-like shooter? Alright, that's a "bulb". And a Colossus. No, I haven't seen remains of a Colossus before.

Well, keep on searching. I hope you will find something interesting.
r138200.n: Tell the scientist about the found material

t:
Stupid Hariuses never believed me! All they want is to live on humans' charity, but we, together with the monolith and the strangers from the sky, can become the masters of the lakes and the rivers! All we have to do is to pray and bring gifts to the monolith. Hariuses didn't like that, but our people have made the choice! Now I am the lord, and Hariuses are pitiful outcasts!

When strangers from the sky will endow me with power, the whole world will kneel before me! Ah... Did I say it out loud?

Ah... It wasn't my idea, I swear! It was that human. I met him near the monolith on the bottom of the lake. Nobody knew what was that stone and where it came from, but he knew! He told us about the strangers from the sky, who sent us the great gift that would lead our people to glory!

It was then that I understood that the Great Fish never answered us because it didn't exist. And the monolith is real, I can feel its power right now!

To arms, my faithful warriors! Defend your Great Prophet! Warriors? Where are you?..

Don't touch me!
r138464.n: To arms, my faithful warriors! Defend your Great Prophet! Warriors?…

t: Have you lost your mind? Do you know what kind of training we have on Umoir? You won't figure out those levers in a year!
r138471.n: Say that you are going to stir Full Moon

t: O, hello! You marvel at the beauty of Full Moon, too? Indeed it's a splendid ship with a professional crew. We will give some hell to those Architects!
r138472.n: O, hello! You marvel at the beauty of Full Moon, too? Indeed it's a…

t:
It's not me! They forced me!

I am just a warehouse clerk. The bandits told me they'd embowel me if I refused to help them. I had no choice!

Please, let me go!

Spare me! I swear I didn't know these were stolen!

A man brings me goods every other day. He was going to come today and take his part of the proceeds. Wait for him! I have nothing to do with that.
Buy from me and no one else!
r138623.n: Buy from me and no one else!

t: The only way to reach the shipyard lies through the city. It is swarming with the Architects, but we don't have other options.
Thanks Tensess! We are saved! Cover me while I'm trying to reach the shipyard.
r138719.n: Tell about the ship in the shipyard

t: The fleet is destroyed, the monsters are everywhere! We're doomed!
r138720.n: The fleet is destroyed, the monsters are everywhere! We're doomed!

t: Great! When the reactor heats up to the right temperature, I will let you know.

It is, but can you see those two dots in the sky? Those are Furies, flying Architects. As soon as we launch the reactor, they will riddle our hull, and we have no cannons to fight back. Somebody's going to have to distract them, and my bet it is going to be you!
r138751.n: Ask whether it is time to sail off

t: Run, of course. We have emptied the local military warehouse, so now our cargo hold bulges at the seams. I hope we don't turn over...
I remember you - we met in the Shore City! I am Bjorn the Seagull, the captain of this unfortunate ship, and I am going to leave this place as soon as possible. Are you coming with us?
r138753.n: I remember you - we met in the Shore City! I am Bjorn the Seagull, the…

t: Something's wrong. You don't feel the same pull that you felt next to other Distortions. Something's missing. You should speak to Unn to find out how this Distortion is different from the previous ones.
The space is shivering, as if being crumpled by an un overwhelming force!
The space swirls up in a colossal whirlpool of vague images.
The space around the Distortion flows and trembles. Some vague images emerge and disappear in it.
r138781.n: The space around the Distortion flows and trembles. Some vague images…

r138795.n: Make the sailor drink the potion

t: Go away... Go away! You don't exist!
r138796.n: Go away... Go away! You don't exist!

t:
It's a miracle you survived after what Savant did to you. He tried to reverse the processes in your organism! Not just for a couple of years back, but more like a couple of centuries!

He attempted to destroy not just your body, but your whole being. If it hadn't been for me, your Spark would have completely disappeared from existence!

I warned you! You better listen to me next time.
Look who's here. How are you feeling? By the way, I was the one who carried you from the battlefield on my back!
r138871.n: Look who's here. How are you feeling? By the way, I was the one who…

t:
This neighborhood is quite troubled - we get knife fights every week, but this is something we couldn't expect.

Look, the body is neatly dismembered, and some of the organs are missing. I may be wrong, but it seems to me that all life energy was drained of the body before it was actually dismembered. It could be a skillful mage, but mages usually don't leave gigantic footprints. This means...
Great! So we've been waiting for you? Listen then...
r138891.n: Great! So we've been waiting for you? Listen then...

t: We found the killers! They were hiding in the basement near the abandoned garden. There was an ugly creature with them - in the dark, I couldn't tell if it was human or an Architect. It tore the guards to pieces and ran to the eastern gates, and the rest of them followed it. We need to go there, now!
There's... There's a monster! We found it!
r138902.n: There's... There's a monster! We found it!

t:
I didn't see their faces... They were wearing masks and floor-length robes. I couldn't take a proper look at the creature - it knocked me down as it rushed by me. It was huge as a troll... and it was whistling!

They ran that way, away from the city. Those two were carrying some bags - I guess they couldn't get too far.

Godrick - this was the poor fella's name - liked to wet his whistle too much for an elf. So we decided to have a couple of beers together, and it was already past midnight when he left. As soon as I closed the gates, I heard something heavy falling on the ground. Then I heard voices above on the wall. I tried to look out of the window, but it was already too dark. While I was lighting a chip, I heard a terrible scream. And a whistle! A voice from above cried something, the whistle stopped, and then again there was a loud rumble somewhere above the roof, and then all went quiet. I walked outside, and - you know what I saw...
Ask what you want, and then get off my back.
r138940.n: Ask what you want, and then get off my back.

t:
This wasn't a man! I swear, it wasn't.

I didn't really see anything - I just heard some noise and looked out of the window. It was very dark, and I only saw a shadow - a huge scary shadow! It had one arm longer than the other. And then I heard a terrifying scream. I hid under the bench and stayed there until the guards arrived...

Well, they called for our patrol squad right after the murder. I was the first one to arrive on the spot. The Elf's body was utterly disfigured - no head, no arms, chest cut open... They seem to have torn him apart really quick - there wasn't even much blood. There were also footprints near the body - they looked human, however, I've never seen such a huge man in my life! Why did they kill the poor guy and why did they need his body parts - I have no idea.
I've seen plenty of things in my life, but nothing like this.
r138949.n: I've seen plenty of things in my life, but nothing like this.

t:
How do you know? Do you see the future? What if you're wrong?

Alright, I will do as you say.
Go ahead! We will cover you back!
So only you can defeat this huge thing that can stop time? If you say so... We will try to keep away from it.
Tonight the Victory Banner will stream above this citadel!
r138982.n: Tonight the Victory Banner will stream above this citadel!

t: If you survive, your battle will be praised in songs in all taverns across the world. If you don't... Well, you still will be praised, but in a much more tragic manner.
So, you're finally ready? Don't just stand here - go finish the monstrosity!

r139164.n: Report on clearing the Sparrow high point

t:
Happy to hear that!

The plan is: we lure the monsters away from the camp - there where they cannot use their quantitative superiority, and then throw bombs on them. We have a whole crate of bombs!

We are a partisan squad.

We hid in the forest after the monsters captured the White Fortress. Sidor, a Demon Hunter, was our chief. He sent us scouting.

And now there's a huge unit of Architects approaching our camp!

Me and the Priden girl want to distract them and lead them away from the camp. Can you help us?
Come on, we will cover you!

There they are! The Architects!

You see the largest one? He is the commander. Without a commander, the rest of the Architects become somewhat dumb. Just like our army, huh.

You take the giant one. Distract him, while we lure the rest of them to the quarry. Meet us there!
Finally! I thought no one would come to help us!
r139457.n: Finally! I thought no one would come to help us!

t: We spotted a big group of Architects. If they reach the camp, we're done. So we need to draw a red herring across their path. We will lure them into the old quarry and then rain bombs on them.
r139486.n: Ask about the details of the plan

t:
Chaos has not devoured your world completely. You understand!

Hold on! Stop destroying the parts of the Whole - it makes laying the Path harder. Wait until Fractal appears in your world. Accept the Ascension! This is the only way to meet your predestination and bring closer the fulfillment of the Design!
r139524.n: Say that you are ready to accept the Path

t:
Your mind is poisoned with Chaos. It is weak. It is shattered.

You don't understand. The Path has not been laid yet. The Path is the Purpose. The Purpose is the Meaning. You cannot stop what has been predestined!

When I lay the Path into your Chaos-stricken world, you will perceive it. You will become a part of the Whole. This is your destiny!
r139525.n: Say that you have already stopped it

t:
The Path is not completed. The Universe is imperfect. Unpredictable. Chaotic.

I am the Order! I am the Architect, and I am the Path that leads to the Absolute. You cannot resist your predestination. Nothing can stop the Path!
r139526.n: Ask why the Order still hasn't defeated Chaos

t: What are you talking about! We are already dead...
Aagh! What is this mist? We're being poisoned...
r139680.n: Aagh! What is this mist? We're being poisoned...

t: The space around the Distortion melts and shifts.
r139688.n: The space around the Distortion melts and shifts.

t: What a monster... How did it get inside the city unnoticed? I will give the guards a dressing down for such negligence! And you should bring these remains to Eladia - maybe she will figure out what kind of creature that was.
So, what's the news? Did you find the killer?
r139725.n: So, what's the news? Did you find the killer?

t: That's some risky talk! I can't let you out when you're like that. They will blame me for releasing a psychopath!

Is he a god? Really? As far as I remember, you participated in the events on Asee-Teph and communicated directly with his Spark.

You are still obviously suffering from memory lapses and need further treatment.
No need to get so excited! This is all for your own good. Have another week in bed...

Don't you have a little sense of humor?

Well, what can I say. If you are willing to survive, there's nothing I can do!

Here, drink this mixture and go away.

Well, I wouldn't argue with that.

Here's the last one. Finish this sentence: don't trouble trouble until...?

Let's assume it is, so what?

You are clearly unable to link up a logical chain and need further treatment.
r139769.n: Because the Astral is an unstable chaotic ultra-matter

t:
Correct! I'm glad you can see the difference between the reality and the teachings of the church.

And the next one: why does the Astral absorb all matters?
r139770.n: A Great Mage from the past, canonized by the church.

t:
And also a maniac and a pervert.

Alright, answer this: who is Tensess?
Neither do I. The next question is: who is Tep?
Clearly, you haven't recovered yet. I need you to stay in the hospital.

First, the Portals stopped working. Then, Adventurer's Stones started behaving unpredictably. But we only realized that was not a coincidence after the White Fortress was attacked...

Unfortunately, we don't have a Great Mage here on Dane, who could have transmitted the message throughout Sarnaut, so we had to face the invasion on our own. The capital is blocked, the northern part is flooded with the Architects, and I have no idea what is going on in the east and in the Iron mountains.
They want war? We will give them war!
r139960.n: They want war? We will give them war!

t: Aho! It seems to be quiet here, but stay alert - the Architects may be anywhere.
r140000.n: Aho! It seems to be quiet here, but stay alert - the Architects may be…

t: Why do you need to go to the Iron City? Are you lying to me, human? No? Then prove it!
r140017.n: Ask about the way to cross the lake

t:
The Architects? Is this how you call the strangers from the sky?

My father became suspicious at once. But he was too old. Antonis yelled that the stone in the middle of the lake is a sign from the above, a sign of the new age of freedom! Phew! But he was very convincing. I tried to bring other Nyxes to their senses, but nobody listened to me. Me and my father had to flee as cowardly shrimps!

Ay me, they are talking about the traitors even on the shore!

So here is what happened. Antonis, the first priest of the Great Fish, betrayed us. He has gone insane! He says, the strangers from the sky are the real gods, the Guards of the Order. He says, they came from the sky to punish the humans who encroach upon our lake. What a guff! Humans have never been our enemies.
Here you go... Just don't let the guards see you!
What are you doing? This is our lake!
r140023.n: What are you doing? This is our lake!

t:
Damn it, why don't you mind your business? You think I didn't know it was Syoma? He is a chatterbox and nothing more, but who stands behind him? Who gave him the leaflets, do you know? Neither do I! I was watching him, hoping to get at something, and now you've ruined everything!

Get lost. No use of you here!
What do you want? Come on, spit it out.
r140035.n: What do you want? Come on, spit it out.

t:
What can we do against that giant thing?! Do you have a cannon in your pocket by any chance? No? Well neither do we!

Listen, can you sneak to Full Moon and see if and of its cannons are still working? It would help us greatly!

There are several crumpled papers on the bottom of the bag. These are the same leaflets that Syoma Rohlin had! The one that Hoof killed right in front of your eyes. So Hoof has something to do with the idiots who are trying to give in to the Architects?

It becomes more and more twisted...
The bag is full with all sorts of things. Looks like Gora was stealing everything he could lay his hand on.
r140177.n: The bag is full with all sorts of things. Looks like Gora was stealing…

t: The handle is polished to a luster after years of exploitation. A faintly visible hallmark is imprinted on the blade - two crossed pickaxes.

A regular axe for cutting logs - there are plenty of these in the camp. But the way the blows were dealt gives away a hand of a professional. There is a small chance that Gora will resurrect after this...
r140183.n: A regular axe for cutting logs - there are plenty of these in the…

t: What do you mean, swish? The mine is closed! You better go away.
What are you talking about? Go to the city and buy there everything you need! They have all sorts of swishes.
I told you to get lost! You had your chance, now you're coming with us!
Who are you? What do you want?
r140196.n: Who are you? What do you want?

t:
It all started with the "inspection". That dreadful minotaur, Hoof, with several suspicious individuals came shouting about the terrible conditions on the mine, and then declared it closed by the order of the Tycoon.

Well, I'm not only a geodesist, but a magician also, so I instantly saw that the order was fake. So I spoke up. Then the mess started...

It was a planned revolt! Part of the workers have already took the side of Hoof and his gang. They grabbed everyone who opposed them, slayed the director and captured all gold and meteo... Oh my! This is classified.
Oh... You... Ivan sent you? It is a nightmare! I thought we were all dead...
r140243.n: Oh... You... Ivan sent you? It is a nightmare! I thought we were all…

t:
Shoish! I know that hallmark!

Before my house was destroyed by the monsters from the void, I used to hunt and sell fresh game in the mines of the Iron City. There were crossed pickaxes on every instrument the miners used. Instruments like these cannot be sold or won. It means this axe belonged to a miner...
r140262.n: Tell about the brand on the axe

t: Greetings! What do you want to talk about?
r140263.n: Greetings! What do you want to talk about?

t:
Hey, what do you think you're doing?

You tryin' to intimidate me? You gonna turn me in to Ivan?

Eeh, alright, alright, I will tell you everything.

Hoof ordered us to get rid of someone without making a fuss. Who am I to contradict him? An order is an order!

Why did we have to kill you - I don't know. Gora Sharashkin brought us the paper with Hoof's signature from the refugees camp. It said that we had to take the Alliance spy for a ride, and that's it.

What do you want with me? Go and find Gora if you don't believe me!

r140360.n: Try to activate it without a key

t: The cleft in the pattern looks like a keyhole.
The old Portal seems to be functioning...
r140363.n: The old Portal seems to be functioning...

t: I am such an idiot! Why didn't I take at least a stick or something to beat off the animals!

I knew there was someone more powerful behind the fanatics and the Prophet. At first I thought it could be a Great Mage, but when I heard them mention the Sculptor - and nobody told me about him for some reason! - everything became clear. However, I can only speculate about the purpose of their experiments. And my speculations are not comforting at all.

As you can remember, faith is a great power which can literally move mountains. The Architects - or should I say the Architect - is using the power of self-assertion. He believes in himself, and he is unflinching in his faith in the special purpose of his mind. But the Sculptor has lost that power when he detached himself from the whole. Now he is trying to compensate it by creating monsters who look like him and have infinite faith in his strength.
Well, let's go! We barely have anything to lose...

Looks like a great battle is upon you. I'm sorry, I will not be a part of it - I don't have the right to risk my life fighting rusty June scrap metal. And also, who else will be there to sing songs about your heroic deeds and pay our last respects to you?
r140832.n: Looks like a great battle is upon you. I'm sorry, I will not be a part…

t: Wow... I didn't expect that from my father!
r140837.n: Wow... I didn't expect that from my father!

t: You quitters! This could be fun... Do you have any other heroes there? These ones won't fight!

The Gates are open; the Seal is broken, but there is a small problem. There it is, right over your head. If I am right, and I am always right, it is called the Void Dragon. It does not belong to our world, and I'm afraid I don't know its weaknesses. All that I can do is alter the gravity so that you can battle the beast from close range, but no more than that. I am hanging on by the skin of my teeth here.
r140843.n: The Gates are open; the Seal is broken, but there is a small problem.…

t:
I... don't know. You see, the world is free now - more than it has ever been before! The shackles are broken, the castles are in ruins... Sarn's madness and the Architect's callousness are no longer a threat to Sarnaut. Now we are the only ones responsible for the future of the world! Now we are the creators. Finally, my dreams will come true...

And you should visit the capitals and tell our governors about what happened here. Maybe the fact that you have saved Sarnaut will soothe their wrath. But if they decide to execute you for teaming up with a traitor and entering a criminal venture that could destroy the world, you will at least die a hero. Maybe I will even mourn... but not for too long - I have many things to do!
r140846.n: Ask what is going to happen next

t:
Well, our plan worked. Sarn and the Architect destroyed each other, this is certain. What's next? I don't know. You see, the world is free now - freer than it has ever been before! The shackles are broken, the castles are in ruins... Sarn's madness and the Architect's callousness no longer threat Sarnaut. Now we are the only ones responsible for the future of the world! Now we are the creators. Finally, my dreams will come true...

And you should visit the capitals and tell our governors about what happened here. Maybe the fact that you have saved Sarnaut will soothe their wrath. But if they decide to execute you for teaming up with a traitor and entering a criminal venture that could destroy the world, you will at least die a hero. Maybe I will even mourn... but not for too long - I have many things to do!
r140848.n: Ask what is going to happen next

t: I hope they don't execute you after all - where else will I find such a reckless and bold hero who would dare to challenge gods?
I can't believe it... We did it!
r140850.n: I can't believe it... We did it!

t: The gates open with a rattle.

"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."
r140950.n: A Golem must follow all human orders except those which implicate inflicting damage.

t:
"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."
r140951.n: A Golem cannot harm humans or allow humans get harmed by omission of action.

t: The massive stone gates slide into the hidden slots in the wall.

"Identification complete: Combat Golem Destroyer, category HK.

Access permitted.

Serious structure malfunction detected. Full diagnostics is recommended".
r140953.n: Sacks with meat! Kill all humans!

t:
"The vocabulary of the Golem requires modification. Analyzing the logical component...

Stage two confirmed.

Stage three: injuring humans".
r140954.n: They can kiss my stone ass

t:
"Stage one confirmed.

Stage two: following human commands."
r140955.n: A Golem is created to deal harm and destruction.

t:
"Identification failed.

Servant Golems are not allowed in the Combat Sector!

Recommendation: use the service entrance."
r140956.n: A Golem has to provide its own security at its best ability.

t:
"Damage detected in the Combat Golem structure. Automatic identification failed. Initiating mental activity identification.

Stage one: analyzing the accordance of the security rules."
r140957.n: Pretend to be a June Golem

t: The key starts to glow dimly in your hands; you can hear rattling and humming behind the gates, then from under the ground a cold mechanical voice says: "No response received. Golem identification initiated."
The huge gates stand in the way.
r140959.n: The huge gates stand in the way.

t: The elevator quietly hums and sparks. Let's hope you don't get stuck.
r141044.n: The elevator quietly hums and sparks. Let's hope you don't get stuck.

t: The elevator quietly hums and sparks. Let's hope you don't get stuck.
r141056.n: The elevator quietly hums and sparks. Let's hope you don't get stuck.

t:
Damn it! The cultists must have somehow carried their treasure away from the lab. Where do we look for the key now?

Alright, let's go back. It's too dangerous here.

Our lord will return! And when he does, you will shiver in agony and eat your rotting insides! No spells will help you - the Spear of Vengeance, created by Sihal from the shards of the divine weapon, will leave you no chance to survive!

This would be a dead frost. The elevator to Tep's chambers is broken, and the corridor to Nihil's chamber is occupied by the cultists and the Mechanoids. Sihal's laboratory is inaccessible as well. I'm not going to discourage you, but I can't risk my men's lives.

If you want my advise, you should capture one of the cultists alive and interrogate them. All sorts of surprises can be waiting for you inside!
r141171.n: Propose to go deeper into the Pyramid

t: The Elevator Control Panel slightly gleams with a green light.
r141179.n: The Elevator Control Panel slightly gleams with a green light.

t:
Nothing has changed here... If the weapon does exist, it is not here.

I'm afraid we'll have to resort to extreme measures. There's no other choice. I will try to revive Tep's memory! I will instill a Spark into his withered remains and make him talk!

You think it won't work? Ha! Don't worry, I've almost depleted his Spark, so he won't be a threat... I'm almost certain. We won't know unless we try!

Well, let's try and resurrect the most dangerous and crazy sorcerer in the world! I always wanted to do something like this...
r141188.n: Ask Klavdia what she is going to do

t: Ah, this so creepy. Tep's dead, but his Pyramid lives on with its own life. We need to get away from here as soon as possible!
r141190.n: Ah, this so creepy. Tep's dead, but his Pyramid lives on with its own…

t: Too late! Even if I die, I will be reborn in the rays of glory! Hahaha!

You have made a mistake, worms. You cannot catch me unawares anymore! You cannot steal my Spark!

I will die - and I will return. I always return! I've been dying for thousands of years, and I have seen all faces of death! Miserable mortals... Your time will come.

Pathetic worms... The damned witch stole my power, so what? Did you achieve anything great, anything worthy or outstanding? Something that would be remembered through the centuries, something that would immortalize your names? You are nothing, just dust and ashes under the feet of the one who has embraced the Creator's design. The likes of you tried to master just one facet of the divine ability, but instead they have awoken powers unattainable for feeble worms!

If it had not been for damned Jeeg, I would have already laid my hands on the second Shard and released the world from the parasites who suck on its blood! I could have made it perfect!
Have you come to laugh at me, you worms? Go on then! Laugh while you still can!
r141198.n: Have you come to laugh at me, you worms? Go on then! Laugh while you…

t: Close your eyes and don't breathe!
r141251.n: Agree to go to Planar Rim

t:
You mean those in the park? I don't like them either. It's so weird to see elves without wings!

I read about those statues in a popular scientific magazine, "Science & Death", in the Supernatural section. The Historians have discovered elven ruins on a distant allod which date back thousands of years. The destroyed city was built by elves before the Change - which means, long before the Cataclysm.

Just imagine how excited the archeologists were - the five elven statues remained intact among the ruins and ash! Too bad the ancient elves didn't like uninvited guests, so the second expedition found only withered remains of the first one at the feet of the statues. The second expedition was found dead on a plundered Astral ship... In its turn, the wrecked ship was discovered on a shore on Suslanger, and then the statues emerged on the black market after a while. Eventually, an anonymous collector bought them.

Some say the statues are cursed, some say that they still preserve ancient elven magic or even the Sparks of the heroes of the past... It seems that you will be the one to unearth the truth.

The Prophet... I wonder where that crazy goblin came from. And also, how can people be such idiots?

Who in their right mind can believe a goblin on stilts, who wears a painted robe and carries a dead Architect core under his arm? This is pure madness. Maybe this is his secret? If one combines pure madness with infinite faith, it can become a terrifying weapon in the hands of a skillful puppet master, namely the Sculptor.

By the way, I heard there was a fire in a slum hospice right after the first Architects' attack on the Iron City. It was burned to the ground together with its patients and the staff, which usually consists of goblins. Some of the bodies were not found. Maybe this twisted faith in the "holy Architects" was born in that fire?

What about him? He's just a greedy boor who can sell his own mother for a handful of gold. However, he is packed into an Assault Shell and carries a Meteorite hammer, but anyway, I don't think he's a problem for you. He's not Tep after all, and definitely not my father... But he will fight for his gold till his last drop of blood, I can tell you that for sure.

If you defeat the Prophet and Hoof soon enough, bandits and fanatics will be beheaded and scattered. Then no one will stand in the way between us and the Sculptor.

This king of the Free Traders, he built himself quite a palace! More of a museum, actually.

Did you know Ivan Chelezny is an acknowledged collector? He lays his hands on all sorts of pieces of art, from silicon axes to elven statues, and the biggest part of his collection is stored in his country residence.

Now that place is occupied by the fanatics, so the museum is slowly turning into either a brothel or a nuthouse.
Here comes our hero! So what are you going to do next?
r141256.n: Here comes our hero! So what are you going to do next?

t: Where is the old one? Have you lost it? How irresponsible!

I know it sounds crazy, but believe me, we have no other options. Neither the League not the Empire have the power to stop a demiurge. A god can be only defeated by another god!

I'm telling the truth. What's the point of lying when my own life is at stake?!

Well, my plan was partly successful - I've brought a power that is able to defeat Sarn to this world. There is still hope! Chaos can only be stopped by Order. Sarn and the Architect are like positive and negative charges. If we manage to bring them together, they will eliminate each other, and even if one of them survives, he will be weakened, so we will handle him somehow.
r141280.n: Ask what Klavdia intends to do next

t:
You see... That was me who showed the Architect the way to Sarnaut! I didn't mean to, of course.

After what happened on Umoir, I was looking for a way to stop Sarn before he turned the world into dust, but I failed time after time until I remembered about the Star Gates. To bring my dad back to life, trap him, and make him do what I want - it all seemed so simple...

I reached the Gates and sent an electromagnetic impulse beyond the limits of our world, and I received an answer... I thought it was my father, so I just waited. But it turned out that my improvised beacon showed the Architects the way through time and space... I only realized it recently!
Close your eyes and don't breathe!
Close your eyes and don't breathe!
Close your eyes and don't breathe!
Close your eyes and don't breathe!
Close your eyes if you don't want to lose your mind.

You're asking for too much, don't you think so?

Alright, for this time, I will give you what you want. Let me see what I have.
r141288.n: Ask for a starter equipment set

t:
How terribly clumsy! You adventurers can't be trusted with anything! Adventure is all you think about!
But this is your lucky day, for I have found your mask. Here, take it and don't lose it again!
r141537.n: How terribly clumsy! You adventurers can't be trusted with anything!…

t: Among all caves on Frontier, I would suspect the one that is being so persistently obstructed by the brave Watchful family. And since the Wormfaces are equally persistent in their attempts to clear it, I am pretty sure that the temple you are looking for is located there.
r141538.n: Ask if there is a cave that matches the description

t: Let me think. Destroyers only dwell on this allod, which means their temple must be somewhere on Frontier. We haven't seen anything looking like a temple, which means it is hidden somehow. Most likely, under the ground. How do we get under the ground? Through a cave, obviously!
r141539.n: Tell about the Destroyers and the key

t: The thoughts you catch erupt into a gamut of emotions, the majority being fury, hatred and bloodlust.
r141656.n: The thoughts you catch erupt into a gamut of emotions, the majority…

t: Your body will be guarded here in the camp, while your Spark will be released. So don't even think of destroying everything around you - your Spark is too fragile for that. You can only survive if you act quickly and inconspicuously!
r141980.n: Your body will be guarded here in the camp, while your Spark will be…

t:
The crystal radiates cold and death.
Its smooth dark sapphire surface conceals a primordial darkness, weaving incredibly beautiful yet horrific coalescing shapes. The sight is enough to drive one completely mad...
r142016.n: The crystal radiates cold and death. Its smooth dark sapphire surface…

t: Great! The more dea... I mean... contestants, the better!
Wow, you're so eager to sacrifice yourself on the altar of science! Wait, it's not the right time yet. I need to prepare for the experiment.
Aha, here is the new victim... Oops, I mean my new assistant. So, shall we set your Spark loose?
r142028.n: Aha, here is the new victim... Oops, I mean my new assistant. So,…

t: Where do you wish to go?

Oh Great Sarn, bring wisdom into the erroneous mind of the creature standing before me! Enlighten his existence, reveal to him the path of the Truth! You have chosen this creature and brought it here! May it become a new soldier in your Holy Army! May your children, the Demons, bring it no harm! And may all your plans come true, oh Great Sarn, Lord of Light, Creator of all existence, both living and dead. We are your faithful servants and grateful children!
Illuminate our path, and may your wrath be upon us should we think wicked thoughts against those who have come here at your will.

The God of Light promised Salvation only to his faithful servants. Sooner or later you will understand this and join us on your own volition, and not of necessity. As for others... Stupid creatures, that's all I can say!
And now you shall heed the vow of one who has been chosen for a new life. One who is expected in the new world! With our very lives, we, the loyal servants of Sarn, are bringing closer the moment when the walls of our lord's prison shall fall. The heathens shall dissolve in the astral without a trace, and the faithful shall live eternally in the new world full of Light and bliss!

Oh, I'm not sure... I can't say... We fought for three days and captured the Watchtower. You should have seen the assault - it was legendary! And not a scratch on me... I was that lucky! But later that night, in the camp... Ignatius Chernov... He offered to take a walk...
There are other things besides war, you know! Just one kiss, oh... I swear it! A single kiss... And that was it... When dawn broke I couldn't get up. A veil of darkness hung before my eyes. What's wrong with me? Help me! Help... Oh...

quests: The Plague of the Wandering Island

t: A strange corpse... Better get a closer look.
r142204.n: A strange corpse... Better get a closer look.

t: Maria is afraid that these are all Nihaz's schemes. That is, his ordering you here to talk peace is but a ruse, while his real reason is power oriented. But I can't say I believe that... I am the patriarch, which means I can read human hearts. I see that you seek the Truth. And not the kind that gets served to you on a platter as one and only. No, the truth you seek is one that you can fully accept with your heart and soul. And we, the faithful servants of Sarn, are its sole keepers across the allods! We are the flame and you are but foolish moths. It was fate that brought you here. And it wasn't you who brought the plague here, I feel it. There's something else in play here. But what?
r142216.n: Maria is afraid that these are all Nihaz's schemes. That is, his…

t:
Ugh, this is a dreadful, cursed stone! No one knows how it came into our world or the kind of power that dwells within. But I do sense a hostile power inside, a power that opposes Sarn. But you know, this shard was supposed to be a sign intended for you.
ZIT Headquarters... Rumor has it that you were involved there, too. Is that true?
Tep's cultists brought the sarcophagus with the body of their idol and resurrected him. Do you remember that? A black stone just like this one helped Tep regain his flesh. Tep used the stone to absorb the Sparks' lifeforce, which transformed his body and cured his own Plague!
Tep has gone completely mad... It appears that he plans to capture all the Sparks in Sarnaut!
But how did this shard end up on the Wandering Island? If anyone can figure that part out, it's Nomarkh Ankh. He is a sage who has done thorough research on Tep's nature.
r142217.n: Ugh, this is a dreadful, cursed stone! No one knows how it came into…

t: Before I can teleport you, clear the destination of enemy soldiers. You don't want to land on the heads of rampant draconids or wormfaces, do you?

At first, when you spoke about a meeting with the Servant of Tensess, I admit I did not believe it. But why would you want to deceive me? So I decided to rouse the enemy, compel them to make mistakes and reveal themselves. The plan worked perfectly.
When I gave the order to speed up construction by revving up the generators to maximum power, that's when that sanctimonious fool had to personally intervene to prevent us from completing the construction. So I caught him red-handed and gave him a glorious thrashing! Sparks everywhere! But his strength seemed inexhaustible, and in your world, alas, I am burdened by certain limitations. So, to be frank, that exploding generator did right by both of us when it interrupted your flight.
Now our enemy is defeated and fled in fear. Moreover, he lost a fair amount of his power, which was absorbed into the Cradle, strengthening it.
And I strongly advise that you forget about the meeting with the Servant of Tensess, the duel and everything else. No one can know about it. Believe me, if you wind up in the Purgatory again, he will pretend that he doesn't know you at all. You are but a grain of sand to him, your life - a moment in time before eyes of eternity. What happened is not your problem, not at all. It isn't even your world's problem, my friend. Your problem is Sarn, and that's what you ought to focus on if you wish to survive. And forget about today's duel.
Man, that "Servant of Tensess" fella is one tough cookie! Or is it just that I lost my form after years without a good fight? No worries, methinks I'll need to recall my glorious past soon enough!
r142508.n: Man, that "Servant of Tensess" fella is one tough cookie! Or is it…

t: I will keep it safe until you find all fragments.
r143350.n: I will keep it safe until you find all fragments.

t: I will keep it safe until you find all fragments.
Ungrateful mortals... Perhaps it's time to teach you some sense, and to give the next lesson myself!

What? You, snot-noses, want to fight me? Ha, ha, ha! You have lost your minds!
Do you really think that you can even scratch me?
r143365.n: What? You, snot-noses, want to fight me? Ha, ha, ha! You have lost…

t:
Tep's cultists did it! Oh, what in the world blew me to the Frozen Peak!... First the astral pirates riddled my ship, so it finally broke to pieces above that wicked place... We thought it a miracle that we were nearly landing and everybody was safe...
Then those cultists appeared out of nowhere! They pinioned us and dragged us somewhere... My clothes were all torn! I finally found myself in a large crate... That's all that I remember...
Damn it! If only I could gain my strength to break away from here, I'll kill those bastards!
r143409.n: Tep's cultists did it! Oh, what in the world blew me to the Frozen…

t:
Hm, it means that I'm dead, all the same. I must admit it' not very pleasant. Last time I did not feel anything, now I feel... weakened.
I fancy if this state is caused by the artifacts we have found in the sealed crypt at ZIT... It is worth thinking about. It seems I died there, at ZIT...
Alright, off you go. We'll meet again soon, anyway...
Alright, off you go. We'll meet again soon, anyway...

D'you want to know what it's like to be a demiurge? The Creator of the worlds and the universe itself? To raise land out of ocean depths and bring down mountains with a wave of your hand? To extinguish stars with a single word? Fat chance! It can't be that something is created out of nothing. Everything in the universe obeys basic laws, even gods. Yes, we can create worlds, but this process is complex, time-consuming and not very entertaining. Thankfully, the two of us don't need a whole world.
You (with my help, of course) will become a creator of a new allod! You will use your will and power to open a path to this allod. You will create a new portal that will be independent from the cultists or wormfaces and lead directly to your destination - the Dead City!
r143590.n: Ask Nihaz about a new portal

t:
You are surprised why the portal to the Dead City is not working, are you? You are right to be surprised. But I have an idea what might be the issue. Oh, no, it's not because of "astral storms" or other whirls.
You see, my friend, it seems to me that cultists simply cheated you. They used you and other adventurers like you to exact revenge on their enemies - wormfaces and draconids. Not only that, they managed to get hold of the fragments of one of my seals... Which puts you in quite a pickle...
You don't really expect them to readily share with you the keys to the Dead City, do you? Ha-ha-ha! The bait I tossed them is too yummy to share.
r143591.n: Ask Nihaz about the path to the Dead City

t:
You! How can you doubt my words? I've warned you that the poison Sarn's minions pour into your ears, can be lethal.
Oh, Sarn... His flattering speeches compelled me to fight him and put him into the most secure prison in the Universe, but even this could not make him mend his ways. My bitter friend understood nothing. He can't live without a crowd of spongers around him...
Is it their lies that made you doubt, if only for a second, that those madmen are our enemies? Wake up! Their goal is to destroy the world! Your world, by the way, where you will still have to live.
I gave you a chance to examine the cult of Sarn from the inside to help expel whatever doubts you may have harbored about who the true enemy of this world is. Look, it doesn't particularly affect me either way: I am a god and I can easily reduce Sarn to jelly along with all his minions. But that would be boring! The problems of this world shall be solved by its inhabitants. And if you care about your own future and the future of Sarnaut, you know what you need to do to ensure its safety.
r143592.n: Ask Nihaz about Sarn and cultists

t: Wormfaces, draconids, demons and Chosen Ones... The game's gaining momentum!
r143594.n: Wormfaces, draconids, demons and Chosen Ones... The game's gaining…

t:
So, you want to save the innocent victim? How generous and kind of you! But before you rush to slaughter the lizards, let me give you a piece of advice.
The Altar and its guardians are protected by unknown and strange spell. With every single lizard slain, these protective powers weaken. You will see it yourself when you slay at least a dozen of them. If you manage to break their defenses, you will save the innocent victim and get the reward.
But you are not the only hero willing to save the girl. There are others who will try to get in your way using a special ability that pushes the competitors back from the victim. You can use it against your opponents, too, but every time you do so, the defenses will grow stronger, and you will have to kill the lizards again. Anyway, your rival's situation will become even worse...
Don't waste your time if you want to save the girl. Better let someone else do the job instead of leaving her to die!

Weeell, everything is raaather simple. The hunt starts at 7 pm and 3 am and lasts for four hours. Those who are late, will always be late... We don't wait for anyone. I will give you an Astral Splitter, a Spectral Energy Absorber, a High-Frequency Generator and a Ghost Trap.
You neeeed to find a ghost and beat it up, but don't kill it! As soon as you drain the ghost of its powers, use these devices to weaken it and catch it with our traaaap.
Now pay attention. To catch Shipwright's Ghost, you need to split its en... energy... Split its energy contour first. Draaain it with the Absorber, then use the Traaap and catch it! Use the High-something Generator to catch Cannoneer's Ghost.
To catch Steersmen, you will need Splitter and Generator.
And don't forget the Trap! Remember, this equipment is fraaagile and exp... experim... It hasn't been tested! Sometimes it malfunctions and emits speeectral energyyy. If it haaappens, don't worry and be coool. It is unpleasant, but not deadly.

Stay right there! Thief, I'll kill you!
Wait, you are not one of them! Weeell... I'm sorry. My mistake...
My name is Iron Hoof, the Ghost Hunter. I hunt ghosts, spirits and other evil beings. How may I help?
r144049.n: Stay right there! Thief, I'll kill you! Wait, you are not one of them!…

t: Shaky steps lead into the dark depths of the cave.

It can't be... You defeated the spirit of the Great Dragon. Finally one of the greatest June Hunters is avenged...
I understand you did it not because of revenge. It's a symbolic act, enemies who fought each other for centuries now rest in peace.
Maybe in future we and Draconids will overcome the consequences of this bloodshed. Thank you. Go now, we must think your words over.
r144111.n: Tell about your victory over the spirit of the Great Dragon

t:
You proved that you were honest and unselfish. You help others and don't ask for rewards... You must be either stupid or generous. I think you are generous.
That's why WE, the Overmind, decided to reward you. Take your reward from the exchange container.

t:
First, don't forget that the majority of those you see are still asleep. Don't bother telling them about Tep or lictors or the illusory world... they won't understand you. Their consciousness will simply reject all unnecessary information.
Second, because you did manage to wake up, this created a gaping hole in the fabric of the illusion. What brought it about? A paradox, someone playing outside the rules. Do you remember how you tried to ruin the Spectacle in Gipat? The same is happening here: developments follow one another in a familiar rut, and to break free of the fetters you must go against the flow.
You must return to the aviaks and play their war games according to their rules until you see an opportunity to derail the narrative and send it careening down a different track. You will see success right away, as every new breach will create new holes, each of which could be used to return to the real world. But don't tarry, either: however well you may hide, sooner or later Tep will want to know who's shooting his toy full of holes.

t:
I was a mage and lived a long time ago, at a time immemorial you might say. False modesty aside, I was a pretty good mage. A great one, to be more precise. These ruins around us are all that remains of my tower. The reason for its downfall was the experiment I held with my colleagues - a complex and incredibly ambitious one that had promised unparalleled power, although it yielded sad results, as you see.
I must add the Divine Gift was at that time non-existent. The dead - imagine that - would not rise but remain dead. To provide for contingencies, I prepared a special spell - a failsafe, if you will. In case of a failure, that spell was to slow down the course of time to allow timely evacuation of the experimenters. Alas, I had underestimated the power of the force we were about to unleash. The energy we released amplified the effect of my spell by an order of magnitude. Time didn't just slow down, it froze altogether. The tower, my disciples and I were trapped within a single instant. It was only thanks to the intervention of a necromancer familiar to you that the time magic could be broken and my freedom of action partially restored.
We're now out of the course of time. Here, we have an eternity for all kinds of talk.
r146529.n: We're now out of the course of time. Here, we have an eternity for all…

t: He he he. I told you: it's good to control the illusion!

Hey, friend! Congratulations, we've won! The illusory world has been destroyed, Tep is dead, all the captives are free and sucking on lollipops in celebration of their release. Everyone is happy, dancing and laughing. Ha ha ha!
But really, you're about to meet your end. And the Resistance will follow suit in an hour. I betrayed you all, muahahaha! I may be a simple sailor, but I know which side the bread is buttered on! Say we are going to defeat Tep... then what? Back to Kania to mop ship decks? But here I can be anyone - a hero, a ladies' man, even a dragon! Instead of dry salted beef I can feast on barbequed Tekyans or spicy aviak wings. I can become an Immortal! Pity, this fate is not for you. Indeed, your fate is death!

t:
I think you already guessed the bitter truth, so I'm only scattering your last doubts. The Great Experiment and the Cataclysm are one and the same!
Blinded by our pride, we searched for ways to grow our power and we found the Sources. We had no idea then what the Seals were and why they were important. Every one of us the Great Mages wanted only one thing - power, free power!
 We tried to subdue the power of the Seals. When our first attempt failed, we continued to attack the Source Seal again and again with the most powerful spells till it cracked and gushed its power into the world. Power against power, understand? The Seals could not bear it, the world's shell cracked and the Astral put an end to the Sarnaut as I knew it. You know the rest - the world in ruins, the legend of the Patrons, the Great Mages being the last stronghold of order in a realm of chaos... But I see that you don't seem to believe my words.

Tep... Till this day, I can't help but marvel at the power hidden in his madness. Who'd ever thought that someone who died once would almost succeed in pulling the whole world into nothingness with him?
I am scared by how easily Tep would extinguish his enemies. By how easily he created an entire world, albeit an illusory one. If that's not divine power, then it's very, very close. And I have an idea what the secret of his incredible power is. The Seals!
I know Tep had experimented with a small fragment of one of the Seals and derived the power to create his Plague from it. It is one of the manifestations of the Sources - the manifestation of Death. But the Pyramid... Illusions, energy, matter, creating new life and influencing the mind. A full set of powers accessible to the Great Mages, reinforced by extremely sophisticated spells. No, I don't believe Tep could achieve all that by himself. After all, until recently he was but a body howling in pain, suspended between life and death. I'm sure someone helped Tep! Someone who knows everything about our Great Experiment.
r147617.n: Ask the Great Mage's soul about Tep
